red_flags.headline: AMC priced $2B 8.875% first-lien notes due 2031 plus $850M term loans to refinance existing debt; $1.12B second-lien commitment also reported.
AMC stockholders approved doubling shares for 2024 equity incentive plan to 50 million; other charter amendments failed to pass.
